verdict.rationale: Poke's docs show it can be triggered by external events (GitHub, CI/CD) and can even delegate real-world tasks to humans (reservations, calls) and act across integrated apps 'through natural conversation,' plus the llms.txt describes it as a 'proactive AI assistant.' However, there is no explicit documentation of a structured multi-step task queue, autonomous background execution status, or a dedicated review/approval step for complex delegated tasks. Missing for 10: explicit multi-step task orchestration docs, background task status/progress tracking, and a defined 'review results' UX beyond ad-hoc chat replies.
